plain.li: [spring] The ground's soft and the days are getting longer. Good digging weather.
[spring] Saw the first bees today, working over the weeds by the camp.
[summer] Plenty of light to work by. We had the first walls up before supper.
[summer] Warm nights, so sleeping rough while we build is no hardship.
[fall] Gathered what wild food we could before the frost. It fills one corner of the storeroom.
[fall] Leaves coming down all around the camp. We'll need a roof before the snow.
[winter] We're starting in the cold, but we're starting. I'll take it.
[winter] Huddled together the first nights. I already know the others' snores.
